description: Generates a cinematic video clip with native audio from text (Veo 3).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output video

duration.description: Duration of the output video in seconds

seed.description: Seed for video generation (0 for random; dropped from wire when 0).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

enhance_prompt.description: Deprecated/ignored at L2 — assembly always sends enhancePrompt=true for Veo 3.

generate_audio.description: Generate audio for the video. Supported by all Veo 3 models.

negative_prompt.description: Negative text prompt to guide what to avoid in the video. Empty string drops the field on the wire (L2 builder).

person_generation.description: Whether to allow generating people in the video

resolution.description: Output video resolution. 4K is only supported by veo-3.1 (non-lite) models.
